To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
A reduced-order feedback controller is designed to control a turbulent channel flow for reducing skin friction, and the controller is augmented by spanwise shear-stress control.

(1) a reduced-order controller for turbulent channel flow can be designed using model reduction techniques; (2) the reduced-order controller reduces drag by 10% when augmented with an ad hoc spanwise control scheme; and (3) the reduced-order control scheme is computationally efficient, requiring less than 0.5% of the computational time of the direct numerical simulation.
